Class RoomController

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.imazolevska.rehearsalbooking.controller.RoomController

    • getRoomBookings

      @GetMapping("/{id}/bookings") public org.springframework.hateoas.CollectionModel<BookingResponse> getRoomBookings(@PathVariable("id") Long id)
      Returns active bookings of a room, so that bands can see which times are taken.
      Parameters:
      id - the room ID from the URL
      Returns:
      the list of active bookings with links to itself and to the room
